profile.summary: A nonprofit that runs after-school programs and summer camps for children in pre-K through 8th grade, mainly in Northern California. Its programs combine science, technology, engineering, arts and math (STEAM) with social-emotional learning. It also offers homework help and tutoring, and partners with school districts.

review.notes: Edventure More (EDMO), EIN 77-0653711, is a 501(c)(3) running after-school and summer programs for school partners, with a GuideStar San Leandro address (2300 Merced St) matching the agenda and a service area including Alameda County. All profile fields are supported by the cited sources; the IRS lists Berkeley and the website a Berkeley PO Box, so the San Leandro headquarters rests on GuideStar alone.
